object.title: The Shapley value is in the core of the energy game
object.statement: Let $G=(V,E)$ be a graph, with the energy game assigning each coalition its graph energy and with $\boldsymbol{\varphi}$ denoting the Shapley value. **Energy-game core conjecture.** For the energy game, the Shapley value is in the core. This conjecture asks whether the Shapley allocation satisfies all coalition inequalities for graph energy; the source gives an example showing that the energy value itself need not coincide with the Shapley value, but provides no resolution of the core-membership question.
object.source_name: Gerardo Arizmendi and Octavio Arizmendi, “The graph energy game”, arXiv:2012.14114 (2021).
object.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.14114

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2020).
